summary: Phase 1 blocked: zone matching extension requires interval splitting (GHR93). The proof structure is correct (strong induction on depth j, universal over arity n), but the zone matching for extended configurations requires orderings between independently zone-matched points, which cannot be derived from 1-var interval types alone. Three resolution approaches identified: (A) use 2-var interval types, (B) simultaneous induction on depth k, (C) game-theoretic formulation.
blockers: Zone matching extension: orderings between independently zone-matched points in the same interval zone are not determined by 1-var interval types. Requires 2-var interval types (interval_2var_nf_types) or a restructured proof.
